rules: A file reference maps to all actual JUnit cases in that file; it is broader than a requirement-specific selector.
An explicit selector maps to the exact function/class and its actual collected parameterizations.
Suggest automated passing only for at least one actual pytest match, all matched cases passing, and no unmatched pytest reference.
Any relevant skip or unmatched pytest reference stays pending; passing does not change implementation labels or assert all original business branches are complete.
Browser and other external scripts are listed separately and are neither assumed pytest passes nor pytest collection failures.
Browser evidence pointers retain their own recorded status and scope; this extractor does not rerun or certify browser coverage.
